title: The 1:34 a.m. Email That Ended Zirtual and More Than 400 Jobs
conflicts: Headcount: about 400 / 400-plus / more than 400 (Entrepreneur, LV Weekly, LV Sun, Fortune) vs Donovan's 'almost 500 at peak'; story says more than 400 lost jobs, nearly 500 only as peak. Funding: almost $5m over three years (Donovan's Medium post, Fortune) vs $5m from ~20 investors over five years (her later Hustle account) vs $3.2m since June (LV Sun, apparently bridge money); story uses almost $5m. Email time: 1:34 a.m. 10 Aug (LV Weekly) vs midnight 9 Aug (her retrospective) vs 4:30 a.m. (an employee, consistent with Eastern time); story uses 1:34 a.m. Her own accounts of when she knew differ (the Monday before, per LV Sun 2015; that spring, per The Hustle); story gives both.
notes: Blame is limited to Donovan's own words; an investor's public criticism and law-firm WARN Act inquiries (no finding located) are left out. Medium post cited via the Internet Archive because medium.com blocks the verifier. Pay in full for time worked rests on her statements only. Quote stance: complicates.
